plain: We collect your name, email and phone number when you sign up.
legal: Upon registration, the Company collects the User's name, email address and telephone number.

plain: We use your email to send you order updates.
legal: The Company uses the User's email address to send notifications regarding the status of orders.

plain: We'll only send marketing emails if you say yes.
legal: The Company shall send marketing communications only where the User has given consent.

plain: You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time.
legal: The User may withdraw consent to receive marketing communications at any time.

plain: We don't sell your personal data.
legal: The Company does not sell the personal data of its Users.

plain: We share your address with the delivery company so they can bring your order.
legal: The Company shares the User's address with its delivery partners solely for the purpose of fulfilling orders.

plain: We keep your data for as long as your account is open, plus 2 years.
legal: The Company retains personal data for the duration of the User's account and for a period of two (2) years thereafter.

plain: You can ask us for a copy of the data we hold about you.
legal: The User may request a copy of the personal data held by the Company concerning the User.

plain: We'll respond to your request within 30 days.
legal: The Company shall respond to any such request within thirty (30) days.

plain: You can ask us to delete your data.
legal: The User may request the erasure of the User's personal data.

plain: We might need to keep some data to follow the law, even if you ask us to delete it.
legal: The Company may retain certain personal data where required to comply with applicable law, notwithstanding a request for erasure.

plain: We use cookies to remember your preferences.
legal: The Website uses cookies to store the User's preferences.

plain: You can turn off non-essential cookies in your browser.
legal: The User may disable non-essential cookies through the User's browser settings.

plain: Our servers are protected with encryption and firewalls.
legal: The Company's servers are protected by encryption and firewall technologies.

plain: Only staff who need it can access your data.
legal: Access to personal data shall be restricted to personnel who require such access for the performance of their duties.

plain: If there's a data breach, we'll tell you within 72 hours.
legal: In the event of a personal data breach, the Company shall notify affected Users within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware thereof.

plain: Our service isn't for children under 13.
legal: The Service is not intended for use by children under the age of thirteen (13).

plain: If we find out we have data from a child under 13, we'll delete it.
legal: Where the Company becomes aware that it holds personal data of a child under the age of thirteen (13), the Company shall delete such data.

plain: We may move your data to servers in other countries, with proper safeguards.
legal: Personal data may be transferred to servers located in other countries, subject to appropriate safeguards.

plain: We use analytics tools to see how people use our site.
legal: The Company uses analytics tools to analyze how visitors use the Website.

plain: Analytics data is anonymized.
legal: All analytics data shall be anonymized.

plain: We'll update this policy from time to time and tell you about big changes.
legal: The Company may amend this Policy from time to time and shall notify Users of any material changes.

plain: Contact our privacy team at privacy@lumenhealth.org with any questions.
legal: Any questions regarding this Policy shall be directed to the privacy team at privacy@lumenhealth.org.

plain: We record calls for training and quality purposes.
legal: Telephone calls may be recorded for training and quality assurance purposes.

plain: CCTV is in use in this building.
legal: Closed-circuit television surveillance is in operation within this Building.

plain: CCTV footage is deleted after 31 days unless needed for an investigation.
legal: CCTV footage shall be deleted after thirty-one (31) days unless required for the purposes of an investigation.

plain: We check your ID to prevent fraud.
legal: The Company verifies the User's identity for the purpose of fraud prevention.

plain: Your health information is only shared with your doctor.
legal: The Patient's health information shall be disclosed only to the Patient's treating physician.

plain: You can correct any wrong information in your profile.
legal: The User may rectify any inaccurate information contained in the User's profile.

plain: We don't use your data to make automated decisions about you.
legal: The Company does not use personal data for the purpose of automated decision-making concerning the User.

plain: Location tracking is off by default.
legal: Location tracking shall be disabled by default.

plain: We will ask before turning on location tracking.
legal: The Company shall obtain the User's consent prior to enabling location tracking.

plain: Payment details are processed by our payment provider and not stored on our servers.
legal: Payment details are processed by the Company's payment service provider and are not stored on the Company's servers.

plain: We'll never ask for your password by email.
legal: The Company shall never request the User's password by email.

plain: Our partners must protect your data the same way we do.
legal: The Company's partners shall be required to protect personal data to a standard equivalent to that applied by the Company.

plain: Job applicant data is kept for 6 months and then deleted.
legal: Personal data of job applicants shall be retained for six (6) months and deleted thereafter.

plain: If you don't give us the required information, we can't open your account.
legal: If the User fails to provide the required information, the Company shall be unable to open an account for the User.

plain: We may share data with police if the law requires it.
legal: The Company may disclose personal data to law enforcement authorities where required by applicable law.

plain: We use your purchase history to recommend products.
legal: The Company uses the User's purchase history to provide product recommendations.

plain: You can opt out of personalized recommendations.
legal: The User may opt out of personalized recommendations.

plain: Data about your device, like browser type, is collected automatically.
legal: Information concerning the User's device, including browser type, is collected automatically.

plain: Voice recordings are deleted after 30 days.
legal: Voice recordings shall be deleted after thirty (30) days.

plain: Employees must lock their screens when leaving their desks.
legal: Employees shall lock their screens whenever they leave their workstations.

plain: Paper records with personal data must be shredded.
legal: Paper records containing personal data shall be disposed of by shredding.

plain: Customer data must not be downloaded to USB drives.
legal: Customer data shall not be copied to removable storage devices.

plain: We appoint a data protection officer who you can contact directly.
legal: The Company has appointed a data protection officer, whom Users may contact directly.

plain: You can complain to a data protection authority if you're unhappy with how we handle your data.
legal: The User may lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority regarding the Company's processing of personal data.

plain: Photos taken at the event may be posted on our website.
legal: Photographs taken at the Event may be published on the Organizer's website.

plain: Tell a staff member if you don't want to be photographed.
legal: Any attendee who does not wish to be photographed shall inform a member of staff.

plain: Biometric data, like fingerprints, is stored only on your device.
legal: Biometric data, including fingerprints, shall be stored exclusively on the User's device.
